study_identification.author_journal_year: Ma et al., Journal of Behavioral Addictions, 2024
study_identification.title: Comparative analysis of cortical anatomy in male participants with internet gaming disorder or tobacco use disorder: Insights from normative modeling

study_characteristics.study_objective: Use normative modeling of cortical thickness (CT) to compare developmental patterns and individual deviations in male Internet Gaming Disorder (IGD) and Tobacco Use Disorder (TUD), to assess commonalities/differences and inform whether IGD aligns with addictions.

dataset_name.reason: HC data were downloaded from the Brain Genomics Superstruct Project (GSP).
dataset_name.supporting_text: In addition, data of 665 male participants were downloaded from the Brain Genomics Superstruct Project (GSP), a large-scale, multi-site brain imaging study (Holmes et al., 2015).

hc_n.reason: Final analyzed HC count reported in Methods and Table 1.
hc_n.supporting_text: ... yielded a final sample of 68 participants in the IGD group, 71 participants in the TUD group, and 665 participants in the HC group (Fig. 1A).

hc_age.reason: HC age statistics reported in Table 1.

hc_sex.reason: All groups are male per title and participants section; HC n is 665.
hc_sex.supporting_text: Comparative analysis of cortical anatomy in male participants... In addition, data of 665 male participants were downloaded from the Brain Genomics Superstruct Project (GSP).

imaging_modality.reason: MRI acquisition section specifies high-resolution T1 structural images.
imaging_modality.supporting_text: High-resolution T1 structural images were acquired on a 3 Tesla Siemens Trio scanner...

analysis_level.reason: CT computed and analyzed at ROI level using Desikan–Killiany atlas; results and tests are ROI-wise.
analysis_level.supporting_text: CT data, based on the Desikan-Killiany atlas, were obtained for each participant... Therefore, the mean group differences were determined by performing ROI-level t-tests on the z-scores of the three cohorts.

preprocessing_pipeline.reason: CT derived via CAT-12 SBM in SPM-12 with DK parcellation.
preprocessing_pipeline.supporting_text: Raw MRI images were processed and analyzed using surface-based brain morphometry (SBM) pipeline available in the CAT-12 toolbox... integrated in the statistical parametric mapping version 12 (SPM-12)... Cortical parcellation was conducted using the Desikan-Killiany atlas.

quality_checking.reason: QC used weighted average IQR and Euler index thresholds with manual review; exclusions quantified.
quality_checking.supporting_text: The quality control process was performed by referring to the weighted average IQR... All participants with IQR ratings below 'C-' were excluded... CAT-12 also calculates the Euler index... we ... excluded participants with square roots greater than 10... we manually examined participants...

quality_checking_detail.answer: IQR threshold (exclude below C-): IGD 8 excluded, TUD 1; Euler index site-wise median-centered sqrt>10 exclusion with manual verification: IGD 2, TUD 6; none in HC.
quality_checking_detail.reason: Explicit thresholds and exclusion counts reported.
quality_checking_detail.supporting_text: All participants with IQR ratings below 'C-' were excluded (no participants were excluded in HC, while 8 were excluded in the IGD and 1 in the TUD)... excluded participants with square roots greater than 10... (no participants were excluded in HC, while 2 were excluded in the IGD and 6 in the TUD).

site_effect_handling.reason: No explicit harmonization or site covariate; mitigated site-related quality via Euler index site-wise thresholding and QC.
site_effect_handling.supporting_text: As the Euler index is closely related to the scanning site, we followed the approach proposed by Rutherford et al. to apply a consistent exclusion threshold across different sites...

site_effect_handling_detail.answer: Site-related differences mitigated indirectly by site-wise median-centering of Euler index and exclusion if sqrt(|Euler_median_centered|)>10; no ComBat/HBR or site covariates used in the model.
site_effect_handling_detail.reason: Paper links Euler to site and applies site-consistent thresholds; no other batch modeling described.
site_effect_handling_detail.supporting_text: ... we subtracted the median Euler index of each site from every participant within it, then took the square root and multiplied by −1, and excluded participants with square roots greater than 10.

model_origin.supporting_text: Gaussian process regression was employed to generate normative models of CT development... The normative range of the model in the HC group was estimated through 10-fold cross-validation and then applied to patients.

clinical_dataset.answer: Locally recruited IGD and TUD cohorts (male only)

diseases_studied.answer: Internet Gaming Disorder (IGD); Tobacco Use Disorder (TUD)

deviation_metric.answer: ROI-wise z-scores from normative model; extreme deviations typically |Z| ≥ 2.6 (also examined |Z| ≥ 1.65).

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Partial Spearman correlations (FDR-corrected) between regional z-score deviations and DSM (IGD) / FTND (TUD), controlling for gender, head motion, and Euler index.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: Both IGD and TUD show widespread cortical thinning; TUD exhibits more individualized and extensive deviations, with opposite CT deviation trends vs IGD in pericalcarine cortex and pars triangularis.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: Compared to HC under cross-validated norms, IGD shows significant positive deviations in bilateral frontal pole and right superior parietal cortex, while TUD shows positive deviations in bilateral frontal pole and lateral occipital cortex. TUD presents greater proportions of extreme deviations (positive: 20.59%; negative: 73.53%) than IGD (positive: 8.82%; negative: 42.65%). Between-group contrasts reveal opposite deviation directions in bilateral pericalcarine cortex (IGD negative; TUD positive) and pars triangularis (IGD positive; TUD negative).
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: ROI-wise (not vertex-wise) analyses may lose local detail; exclusion of other addictions relied on verbal inquiry (no biochemical scales); GSP lacks IGD/TUD diagnoses so HC may include such cases; cross-sectional design limits developmental inference.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: Normative modeling and NPMs highlight individual heterogeneity beyond group averages; thresholds (|Z|≥2.6/1.65) were used to map extreme deviations and summarize subject-level abnormality percentages.

general_notes.general_notes: Scanner: 3T Siemens Trio; acquisition TR=2000ms, TE=3ms, TI=1100ms, 1mm isotropic. Empirical Bayes parameter estimation; ROI-level t-tests with Bonferroni-Holm correction.
